posts.text:
DHS has proposed increasing the fee for adjudicating Form I-246, Application for a Stay of Deportation or Removal, from $155 to $755.

The proposal, published in the Federal Register on May 7, 2026, describes the change as adjusting the fee to recover costs, noting the amount has not been adjusted.

The population this reaches is defined by the form itself: people who apply for a stay of deportation or removal. Nothing in the document changes who may file or on what grounds — only the amount charged to adjudicate the application.

This is a proposed rule. It is not in force, it imposes no obligation on anyone today, and it may never be finalized. Our archive records no effective date for it.
